'''Kazimierz Rzążewski''' (born 9 November 1943) is a Polish theoretical physicist and professor of physical sciences, specializing in [[quantum optics]] and the physics of [[ultracold atom|ultracold quantum gases]].

== Biography ==
In 1966, Rzążewski graduated from the [[University of Warsaw]], where he defended his doctoral thesis in 1972 and completed his [[Habilitation|habilitation]] in 1979. He worked as an assistant professor at the university until 1980. That year, he joined the Institute of Theoretical Physics of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] (PAS), which would later become the {{ill|Center for Theoretical Physics of the Polish Academy of Sciences|pl|Centrum Fizyki Teoretycznej Polskiej Akademii Nauk}}. He served as the director of the center from 1999 to 2002. In 1988, he officially received the academic title of professor of physical sciences.<ref name="ludzie-nauki">{{cite web |url=https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/uOCWmarhfAj|title=Prof. dr hab. Kazimierz Maria Rzążewski |website=Ludzie Nauki |publisher=National Information Processing Institute |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref> He has published in the fields of [[quantum mechanics]] and [[atomic physics]].<ref>{{cite book |title=Współcześni uczeni polscy. Słownik biograficzny. Tom V. Suplement A–Ż |publisher=Ośrodek Przetwarzania Informacji |location=Warsaw |year=2006 |pages=707–708 |isbn=83-916278-4-5}}</ref>

From 1993 to 2000, he was a faculty member at the {{ill|School of Exact Sciences|pl|Szkoła Nauk Ścisłych}} (SNS) and served as its [[Rector (academia)|rector]] from 1994 to 1997.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://slownikpolskiejmodernizacji.pl/index.php/Rz%C4%85%C5%BCewski_Kazimierz |title=Rzążewski Kazimierz |website=Słownik polskiej modernizacji |access-date=27 August 2026 |language=pl}}</ref> From 2000 to 2011, he was employed as a professor at the [[Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University in Warsaw]] (UKSW).<ref name="ludzie-nauki" /> 

Throughout his career, Rzążewski held positions as a [[visiting professor]] at several international institutions, including the [[University of Duisburg-Essen|University of Essen]], the Institute of Optics at the [[University of Rochester]], [[JILA]] in Boulder, Colorado, the [[Université catholique de Louvain|Catholic University of Louvain]], the [[Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics]] in [[Garching]], and the [[University of Stuttgart]], which also awarded him an [[honorary degree|honorary doctorate]] (Dr. h.c.) in 2014.<ref>{{cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2QlA_hyhRg |title=Ehrendoktorwürde für Prof. Kazimierz Rzazewski |publisher=[[University of Stuttgart]] |date=2014 |via=YouTube |access-date=27 August 2026 |language=de}}</ref>{{better source needed|date=September 2026}}
He has been elected a [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]] and a Fellow of the [[Institute of Physics]] (UK). He has served as an editorial board member for the ''[[Journal of Physics B]]'' and a co-editor of ''[[Europhysics Letters]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://archiwalna.fnp.org.pl/prof-kazimierz-rzazewski-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2015/|title=Prof. Kazimierz Rzążewski – Laureat Nagrody FNP 2015 |publisher=Foundation for Polish Science |date=28 October 2015 |language = pl|access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>

Beyond his work in quantum mechanics and atomic physics, Rzążewski has conducted research into the mathematical properties of electoral systems. In 2014, he co-authored the book ''Każdy głos się liczy. Wędrówka przez krainę wyborów'' (Every Vote Counts: A Journey Through the Land of Elections) alongside {{ill|Wojciech Słomczyński|pl}} and [[Karol Życzkowski]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Rzążewski |first1=Kazimierz |last2=Słomczyński |first2=Wojciech |last3=Życzkowski |first3=Karol |title=Każdy głos się liczy. Wędrówka przez krainę wyborów |publisher=Wydawnictwo Sejmowe |year=2025 |edition=2nd |isbn=978-83-7666-809-3 |language=pl}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
* 1999 – [[Humboldt Research Award]] from the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://service.humboldt-foundation.de/pls/web/pub_laudatio.main?p_lang=en&p_fgb=G3 |title=Humboldt Network: Awardees (Particles, Nuclei and Fields) |website=Alexander von Humboldt Foundation |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>
* 2006 – [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Gold Cross of Merit]] for contributions to science.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20070100108 |title=M.P. 2007 nr 10 poz. 108: Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej |website=ISAP |publisher=Sejm |date=10 October 2006 |language=pl|access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>
* 2013 – Galileo Galilei Medal awarded by the [[International Commission for Optics]] for achievements in optics.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.e-ico.org/blog/awards/galileo-medal/ |title=ICO Galileo Galilei Medal Award |website=International Commission for Optics |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>
* 2015 – [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] for his discovery of the phenomenon of magnetostriction in [[ultracold atom|ultracold dipolar gases]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://archiwalna.fnp.org.pl/en/fnp-prize-2015-recipients-chosen/ |title=FNP Prize 2015 Recipients Chosen |publisher=Foundation for Polish Science |date=28 October 2015 |access-date=27 August 2026}}</ref>
